name: Pat Meyer
occupation: Former Park County assessor (served until retiring at the end of December 2024)
prior_offices: Park County assessor (won the November 2022 general election; retired at the end of December 2024)
background: Pat Meyer served as Park County assessor after winning the November 2022 general election and retired at the end of December 2024. The Powell Tribune reported in February 2025 that after his retirement, First Deputy Assessor Terry Call was appointed interim assessor and later won the 2026 election. No separate public-record account of Meyer's earlier occupation or education was found in the records reviewed for this Profile.

sources.name: Powell Tribune, Feb. 3, 2025, Judge picks deputy assessor to fill vacant role
